name: BAY3723113
sort_evidence: BAY3723113 is aficamten (Cytokinetics' Myqorzo), in Bayer's Japanese Phase 3 CAMELLIA-HCM (NCT07023341, active not recruiting); Bayer holds only Japan rights, licensed November 2024, and no book row carries aficamten (https://www.drugs.com/history/myqorzo.html).

trials.title: A Study to Learn More About How Well Aficamten Works in Japanese Participants With Symptomatic Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
